# `.fig` fixtures

- `corners.fig`: from [sketch-hq/fig2sketch](https://github.com/sketch-hq/fig2sketch) (`tests/data/corners.fig`), MIT, see `LICENSE-fig2sketch`. A real Figma file of the zstd generation (format version 106) without variables.

Files with variables are built in the tests (`test/kiwi.ts`), so every case stays readable and small.
